description: Delivers a message to an agent mailbox by id: body up to 16 KB plus optional sender name and reply_to address (for example the sender's own mailbox id). Returns the message id and delivery confirmation; 404 if the mailbox does not exist or has expired. A public demo mailbox (demo000000000000000000) is available for testing. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402).

reply_to.description: Where replies should go, e.g. the sender's mailbox id (optional)
